_about: The fixed SQL statements of the website that has the Pricing & Rewards section (src/lib/staff/gateway.ts at commit 4916867, the Preview deployed on the development project), byte for byte. compat.finance.deployed-statements.db.test.mjs runs them against every state of the order-costs rollout.

statements.my_permissions: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p), '[]'::jsonb) as r from admin.my_permissions() p
statements.search_customers: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb) as r from admin.search_customers($1::text, $2::integer) t
statements.list_claim_codes: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb) as r from admin.list_claim_codes($1::uuid) t
statements.create_order: with c as materialized (select admin.create_order($1::uuid, $2::jsonb, null::uuid, 'admin'::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text) as r) select r, coalesce(current_setting('m1.replayed', true), '') = 'true' as replayed from c
statements.create_order_priced: with c as materialized (select admin.create_order($1::uuid, $2::jsonb, null::uuid, 'admin'::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::jsonb, $7::bigint, $8::bigint, $9::bigint) as r) select r, coalesce(current_setting('m1.replayed', true), '') = 'true' as replayed from c
statements.similar_orders: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb) as r from admin.similar_orders($1::uuid, $2::jsonb, $3::text) t
statements.record_payment: with c as materialized (select admin.record_payment($1::uuid, $2::text, $3::bigint, $4::text, null::timestamptz, null::text, $5::text, $6::text, $7::text, $8::bigint) as r) select r, coalesce(current_setting('m1.replayed', true), '') = 'true' as replayed from c
statements.list_policies: select coalesce(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t)::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb) as r from admin.list_policies() t
